publishing.notes: Pure static HTML/CSS/JS with relative paths. Published from a separate public demo repository so the private proof-of-work repository stays private.

snapshots.title: Job-agent current-UX snapshot with company research KPI cards
snapshots.change_summary: Creates a static clickable UX snapshot modeled on the current Next.js job-agent frontend: Today, Find, job detail tabs, company research, Apply/CV, and supporting surfaces.
snapshots.why: Reviewers need to see how the working application actually looks, not a separate conceptual portfolio UI.
snapshots.rollback_note: Keep this as the app-faithful baseline; use the older portal framing only as an index if the app snapshot becomes too broad.

snapshots.title: PKM knowledge feed mock
snapshots.change_summary: Adds a static clickable knowledge-feed and source-capture surface.
snapshots.why: Shows supporting proof around ingestion, source quality, tagging, and retrieval workflows.
snapshots.rollback_note: Keep as a lightweight supporting proof point; do not let it overshadow job-agent.

snapshots.title: Household budget dashboard mock
snapshots.change_summary: Adds a static clickable dashboard with liquidity, budget, import review, and household-scope panels.
snapshots.why: Shows supporting proof around financial domain modeling and household/shared-account state.
snapshots.rollback_note: Use as the baseline sample-data demo for future budget-app screenshots.
